changelog:
Initial release — end-to-end SEO content automation:

- Generates SEO-optimized blog posts and articles from a single keyword or batch file
- Includes automated keyword research, competitor analysis, and SERP-aware topic selection
- Builds draft structure with title, meta, headings, FAQ, and unique angles before writing
- Produces two ready-to-publish formats: clean Markdown and WordPress-ready HTML (with meta tags and schema markup)
- Outputs on-page SEO elements, image and internal/external link suggestions, and full schema (JSON-LD)
- Batch mode supports multi-article creation and automated internal linking map
- Built-in quality checks for keyword targeting, engagement, word count, and on-page SEO best practices
summary: Generate fully SEO-optimized blog posts and articles with keyword research, competitor analysis, and SERP-aware content. Use when creating SEO content, blog posts, articles, or content for clients.
